description: Repairs r-fmt-2b/fx-decimal-update: the Decimal Fm was a precision-38 column that DAO cannot read, so UPDATE Fx SET Fm = 12345 (RecordsAffected 1) had no public confirmation. Which bytes change when the Decimal field (Fx.Fm, DECIMAL(28,0)) of row 5 is updated to the integer 12345 by UPDATE; the value is read back through DAO Field.Value and through SQL CStr(Fm). Fx: ten rows on one small table (ID Long key; Byte Fb, Long Fl, Currency Fc, Date Ft, GUID Fg, a Text Vt and Decimal Fm made by ADO DDL as DECIMAL(28,0), so DAO can read it); row 8 is Null in Fb, Fl, Fc, Ft and Fm; elsewhere Fm = ID * 100. Images: 'before' (the fixture copy as given), then one kept image of the closed file after each step; every step opens the database read/write, makes its mutation and closes it, with the DBEngine still alive.
retentionNote: Designed r-fix-fmt-sort probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
